column1: # checklist: complete. It lists each model as five keys (one per TmdSource array); the usage lines above are keyed `gameplay_effect_<addr> (TmdSource D_...)` for the model as a whole.

# answer to the weapon sweeps: the shell-casing models are gEffectBulletCasingModel (P08, M93R, M950, MP5A5, Mongoose reload), gEffectP229CasingModel (P229, NPC pistols), gEffectRifleCasingModel (M4A1 family, M249) and gEffectShotgunShellCasingModel (PA3, SP12, AS12, weapons/gunblade/package); gEffectThrownModel91 is a thrown box emitted by grenade pistol, M4A1 launcher and MM1 reload controllers; its physical identity is unproven. 'The thrown model gEffectRifleCasingModel' is the rifle casing.

# there is NO muzzle-flash model: none of the five models is one. Every flash is sprites - EFFECT_MUZZLE_FLARE (0x60034 effectSpriteTask34), EFFECT_MUZZLE_FLARE_ADDITIVE, EFFECT_MUZZLE_SPARK (0x60035), EFFECT_MUZZLE_SPARK_THROWN (getTPage(0, ADD, 512, 0) with getClut(304, 265), 32x32 cells, src/gameplay/effect_tasks.c:1598-1599) and _effectDrawMuzzleFlash - plus the transient point light. Their rectangles on rooms/akropolis/west_elevator_hall/image are image uses, outside this model checklist; only the thrown-spark page/CLUT above was read.

# naming is wrong in include/gameplay/effect_ids.h: EFFECT_RIFLE_MUZZLE_FLASH_MODEL (0x60067, :300) is the rifle casing; EFFECT_P229_SHELL_CASING's comment (:297) says 'thrown from the muzzle', it is thrown from the ejection offset _gEffectWeaponEmissionOffsets; EFFECT_091 (:428) selects the thrown box whose physical identity remains unproven.

# mechanical data: tools/peassets/model_textures.tsv has no row for any gameplay_effect model and `asset_residency.py check --verbose` prints nothing for them; `asset_residency.py show gameplay` lists the carrier 0/gameplay with 0 uploads. All five read rooms/akropolis/west_elevator_hall/image page (576,0) with rooms/akropolis/west_elevator_hall/palette rows 0-1, a 16x40 strip at u 240..255, v 0..39 that no sprite code was seen to use.
